name: detectors/ipv4-not-product-version
description: A dotted quad right after a product token and slash (Chrome/154.0.0.0, Edg/, Version/) is a version, not an IP: left alone, no counter used. Real IPs in a path segment, free text and a body are still mapped, in order.
